title: Tenancy Share of the Security Advance on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
The security advance taken with the replacement of a returned payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement carries a tenancy share, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date to the handling date:

- an agreement in force **60 months or more** posts **half** the advance (50 percent);
- one in force **36 to 59 months** posts **three quarters** of it (75 percent);
- a younger agreement posts it in full.

The share multiplies the advance before it is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Ladder

| Whole calendar months since move-in | Share of the advance posted |
|---|---|
| under 36 | 100% |
| 36 to 59 | 75% |
| 60 or more | 50% |

## Hypothetical figures
An advance of 2 months at $148.50 each on an agreement in force 40 months: 75 percent of $297.00 is $222.75. The same advance on an agreement in force 72 months: $148.50.
